SignedOut.title: Signed out
SignedOut.notAdminExplanation: This account can't administer Kale (it doesn't hold auth.Admin); it has been signed out.

NotAdmin.title: Not allowed
NotAdmin.explanation: This account can't administer Kale (it doesn't hold auth.Admin).

Forms.invalid: AuthService refused the change; check the values.
Forms.notFound: It no longer exists (perhaps removed in another tab). Reload the page.
Forms.secretShownOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only this once (AuthService keeps only its hash). Store it as the application's Podman secret.

Applications.title: Applications
Applications.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Can't be changed later.
Applications.name: Name
Applications.onePerLine: One address per line; https (http only for localhost).
Applications.confirmRotate: Replace the client secret of {key}? The current one stops working at once.
Applications.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {key}? Nobody can sign in to it, and its open sessions stop being accepted.
Applications.adminUiSecret: The admin UI's own secret: replace it with the admin UI's Podman secret, not here.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.explanation: The page couldn't be loaded or the change couldn't be made. AuthService may be unreachable.

Roles.title: Roles of {key} ({name})
Roles.obsolete: (obsolete: no longer registered by the application)
Roles.noOperations: The application hasn't registered any operations yet (it does at startup).
Roles.name: Name
Roles.obsoleteGrants: Also holds obsolete operations, dropped when the operations are saved: {operations}
Roles.confirmDelete: Delete the role {name}? Its open sessions stop at once, and users and groups lose it.
Roles.confirmOperations: Save the operations of {name}? Everyone with this role gains or loses them at once.
